recent_alerts.title: URGENT: Imminent Slope Failure Threat along NH-13
recent_alerts.description: 24h rainfall exceeded 138mm. Subsurface soil saturation reached 74.2% with active shear displacement of 4.8mm detected by sensor SNS-TWG-GM-01.
recent_alerts.recommended_actions:
1. Restrict all civilian transit along NH-13 Km 42-49.
2. Evacuate 45 hillside homesteads to Tawang Higher Secondary Shelter.
3. Position NDRF 12th Bn clearance bulldozer at Tawang bypass junction.
recent_alerts.nearest_center: Tawang Community Shelter & STNM Emergency Cell

recent_alerts.title: CRITICAL: Debris Flow Warning on NH-10 Lifeline
recent_alerts.description: Continuous cloudburst event (184mm in 24h). GNSS displacement accelerating at 8.6mm/day. Extreme probability of mudslide blocking Teesta corridor.
recent_alerts.recommended_actions: Activate Siren Alert 3. Halt vehicular movement at Rangpo check-post. Divert freight via Lava-Kalimpong alternate route.

recent_alerts.title: HIGH ALERT: Torrential Precipitation & Karst Slump
recent_alerts.description: Precipitation crossed 240mm threshold. Soil moisture at 88%. Waterfall cascade scouring base of Sohra escarpment.
recent_alerts.recommended_actions: Issue yellow alert to all downstream village councils (Dorbar Shnong). Avoid canyon trek routes.

recent_alerts.title: ELEVATED RISK: Minor Toe Sloughing near BCT Km 68
recent_alerts.description: Pore pressure rising in schistose formation. Minor rockfall debris observed on shoulder.
recent_alerts.recommended_actions: BRO (Border Roads Organisation) Project Vartak patrol dispatched. Single-lane movement advised.
